title: Payment Methods Policy
content: FootFlex accepts multiple secure payment options processed via Razorpay. Supported methods include UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Maestro), Net Banking (all major Indian banks), Mobile Wallets, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible pin codes.
